title: Prokaryotes vs Eukaryotes
text: Prokaryotes lack a nucleus and membrane-bound organelles. Eukaryotes have a true nucleus and organelles like mitochondria and endoplasmic reticulum.

title: Oldest Life Forms
text: Prokaryotes were the first life forms on Earth (about 3.5 billion years ago). 'Pro' means before, 'karyon' means nucleus - so prokaryotes evolved before organisms with nuclei. Bacteria are the most common prokaryotes.
